steps.title: Grow L929 fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Seed L929 fibroblasts in two T75 flasks with L cell media (Recipe 9) and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for ~2 days until confluent.

steps.title: Detach L929 cells
steps.instruction: Remove existing media, add 4 ml TrypLE to each flask, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 5 min (or until fully detached).

steps.title: Collect and centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml L cell media to each flask, transfer the suspension to a 50 ml conical tube, centrifuge at room temperature 250–300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in L cell media.

steps.title: Count and plate for conditioned media
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µl trypan blue with 10 µl cell suspension, load 10 µl onto a hemocytometer, count cells, then plate 2.5 × 10⁵ cells in 75 ml L cell media per T225 flask; rock flasks for even coverage.

steps.title: Incubate L929 flasks
steps.instruction: Incubate the T225 flasks at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 10–12 days, monitoring for cobblestone morphology.

steps.title: Harvest and filter conditioned media
steps.instruction: Remove media from flasks into 50 ml conical tubes, centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, combine supernatants, vacuum‑filter through a 250 ml filter unit (0.2 µm PES), and collect filtrate.

steps.title: Aliquot and store media
steps.instruction: Aliquot 45 ml of filtered conditioned media into 50 ml conical tubes, store at –20 °C; thaw at 37 °C when needed for bone‑marrow macrophage differentiation.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and isolate femurs
steps.instruction: Euthanize mouse by CO₂ followed by cervical dislocation, remove femurs in a biosafety cabinet, keep bones intact, and trim ~1 mm off each end to expose the marrow cavity.

steps.title: Flush bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Place each femur over a 50 ml conical tube, attach a 10 ml syringe filled with DMEM, insert a 26G needle into the bone opening, and flush with 5 ml DMEM; repeat for both femurs.

steps.title: Filter bone marrow suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the combined marrow suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer into a fresh 50 ml conical tube to remove tissue clumps.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature 250–300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in ~1 ml residual media, add 1 ml ACK lysis buffer (Recipe 2), incubate 60 s, then add 9 ml DMEM.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend in differentiation media
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at room temperature 250–300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in ~10 ml bone‑marrow differentiation media (Recipe 1).

steps.title: Seed cells for differentiation
steps.instruction: Transfer ~5 ml of the cell suspension into a non‑tissue‑culture‑treated Petri dish containing a total of 20 ml differentiation media; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 6 days, checking for elongated morphology.

steps.title: Wash and detach differentiated BMDMs
steps.instruction: On day 6, remove media and wash cells three times with 10 ml 1× DPBS (with Mg & Ca). After the final wash, add 3–4 ml per plate of 10 mM EDTA in 1× DPBS (without Mg & Ca, pH 7.2–7.4) and incubate at 37 °C for ~5 min until cells lift.

steps.title: Collect and resuspend BMDMs
steps.instruction: Add 5–8 ml per plate of DMEM with 10 % FBS (Recipe 5), transfer cells to a 15 ml conical tube, centrifuge at room temperature 250–300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 10 ml DMEM + 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Count and plate assay cells
steps.instruction: Count cells with a hemocytometer (expect 6–8 × 10⁶ cells per plate); seed 2 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 12‑well tissue‑culture‑treated plate (1 ml per well), placing a coverslip in one well (recipient) and leaving the other well without a coverslip (donor). Incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Stain donor cells with CFSE
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of Cell Trace CFSE (final 5 µM) in dPBS (with Mg & Ca) to each donor well; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 20 min.

steps.title: Stain recipient cells with Far Red
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of Cell Trace Far Red (final 1 µM) in dPBS (with Mg & Ca) to each recipient well; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 20 min.

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Wash each well three times with 1 ml pre‑warmed (37 °C, 20 min) DMEM containing 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Assemble co‑culture with coverslip
steps.instruction: Invert the coverslip bearing recipient cells onto the donor well so that cells are in direct contact; incubate 30 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Fix cells for microscopy
steps.instruction: At the desired time point, add 1 ml 4 % PFA to the well and incubate at room temperature for 7 min (EEA‑1 staining) or 10 min (other antibodies).

steps.title: Wash and perform immunstaining
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips three times with 1 ml 1× DPBS (with Mg & Ca), carry out the desired antibody staining (e.g., LAMP‑1), then wash again three times with 1 ml 1× DPBS.

steps.title: Mount coverslips on slides
steps.instruction: Place ~10 µl mounting medium with DAPI on a microscope slide and invert the coverslip onto the drop.

steps.title: Prepare Francisella agar plates
steps.instruction: Streak Francisella tularensis freezer stock onto chocolate agar plates and incubate at 37 °C for 3 days.

steps.title: Grow bacteria in CDM
steps.instruction: Pick 4–6 colonies, suspend in 3 ml Chamberlain’s defined medium (CDM), and incubate overnight at 37 °C in a shaking water bath.

steps.title: Harvest bacteria and adjust OD
steps.instruction: Spin down 2 ml of the overnight culture at room temperature 20,000 × g for 2 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 ml PBS, blank OD600 with 1 ml PBS, and measure; ensure OD600 is 0.34–0.36 (continue incubation if lower).

steps.title: Infect donor BMDMs
steps.instruction: Add bacteria to donor wells to achieve MOI 100 in a total volume of 250 µl of DMEM containing 10 % FBS; incubate 2 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add gentamicin post‑infection
steps.instruction: Add gentamicin to a final concentration of 10 µg/ml in 500 µl total volume per well.

steps.title: Replace media and re‑assemble co‑culture
steps.instruction: Twenty hours after infection, replace media on all wells, invert the recipient‑coverslip onto the donor well for 30 min at 37 °C, then return the coverslip to its original well.

steps.title: Fix and stain infected samples
steps.instruction: Fix, wash, immunostain, and mount coverslips as described in steps 21–23.
